metadata.description: Rem's buddy: personal Claude Code guards — branch safety, conventional commits, no AI attribution, MR fixing, GitLab issue loop

plugins.name: git-workflows
plugins.description: Conventional commits, GitLab MR fixing, plus a PreToolUse hook enforcing branch safety

plugins.name: attribution-policy
plugins.description: Never add AI/tool attribution to commits, MRs, PRs, or docs — skill guidance plus a PreToolUse hook that blocks it in git commit/tag/notes/merge

plugins.name: issue-workflow
plugins.description: GitLab-issue-driven development loop: read the delivery issue, analyze, plan, implement, open MR, post progress back on the issue
